Proves AR-6's generic `eq` operator against a `boolean` field. AG Grid core has no dedicated boolean filter UI (confirmed against `iSetFilter.ts`): a boolean column's filter always routes through the set-filter shorthand, which the adapter compiles to the dedicated unary `true`/`false` operators (see cases 044/045), never to generic `eq`/`neq` — so there is no native `filterModel` wire shape that reaches `eq` for a boolean field. This fixture instead uses the `customFilters` (OQ-11) extension point to inject the IR fragment directly, proving the compiler layer's `eq` support across AR-7's full type matrix independent of today's adapter/UI reachability. See the category README for this rationale, applied identically to cases 006/036/038.
